product: Language Learning App — Nordic Editorial mobile (working description; final brand TBD)
sourceOfTruth: Figma for approved visual; curriculum blueprint & architecture for learning-domain behaviour; code for native runtime decisions
recordStatus: Figma screenshots and IDs verified on 2026-11-10. Paths are recommendations for Expo Router, not existing application routes. Product-identity amendment: Finnish V1, Swedish future; app brand TBD, Figma Suomi wordmark provisional.

screens.name: Home
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Unit 4 — Where are you? (3/6 lessons). Next lesson hero and review preview.
screens.implementationRequirements: Single dominant Continue action; show current stage/unit/lesson dynamically; display due review and genuine capability preview; Progress/Settings remain secondary destinations.
screens.navigationContract: Home tab; Continue to current lesson; Review; Course; Library; Progress preview; Settings.

screens.name: Grammar Lesson
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Unit 4.2 — Saying where something is: talo → talossa; kauppa → kaupassa; Helsinki → Helsingissä.
screens.implementationRequirements: Structured lesson step with concise explanation, visual noun + suffix pattern, examples, takeaway and Continue; supports any unit, not only inessive.
screens.navigationContract: Back to lesson context; Continue advances lessonStep cursor.

screens.name: Exercise / Default
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Olen Helsingissä. Choose from/from in/to Helsinki; answer taps evaluate in the mockup.
screens.implementationRequirements: Render question from content data; selection is temporary UI; disable repeat submission while evaluating; reserve space for feedback.
screens.navigationContract: Answer choice → evaluate; next lesson step after feedback; back to lesson.

screens.name: Exercise / Correct
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Correct answer “in Helsinki”; exactly + concise -ssä explanation.
screens.implementationRequirements: Keep answer geometry unchanged, display selected correct option and explicit checkmark, update only scored knowledge targets once.
screens.navigationContract: Continue to next lesson step; not necessarily a route.

screens.name: Course
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Four stages; A1 Foundations eight units; Unit 4 currently 3/6; lesson 4.4 is current.
screens.implementationRequirements: Accordion/chapter journey with clear current unit, six lesson statuses, later chapters and stages; distinguish completed versus familiar.
screens.navigationContract: Course tab; current lesson resolved from saved cursor; other chapter entry as available.

screens.name: Review / Landing
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Sample: 10 items due (8 words, 2 grammar), about 5 minutes.
screens.implementationRequirements: Due count computed by review scheduler, not static; concise word/grammar preview; Start Review only if items available.
screens.navigationContract: Review tab; Start Review → active session; empty queue → Nothing Ready.

screens.name: Review / Default
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Question 3/10: En tiedä. Four options; QA added “I’m not sure yet”.
screens.implementationRequirements: Review item may test word, phrase or grammar; “not_sure” must be a real scored result separate from Almost; render from authored exercise.
screens.navigationContract: Evaluate choice or Not sure, show feedback in same session, then advance.

screens.name: Review / Correct
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: “En tiedä.” = “I don’t know”; short first-person negative explanation.
screens.implementationRequirements: Selected answer and feedback rendered without layout shift; scored result scheduled by domain; continue until queue ends.
screens.navigationContract: Continue to next review item, or Session Complete when the last item is answered.

screens.name: Vocabulary Library
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: haluan, missä?, täällä, vielä, paljon, siellä; En tiedä., Voinko…?, Minulla on…
screens.implementationRequirements: Encountered lexical items + phrases; lemma and learner-facing forms distinct; search/filter from local content/progress; no fake 94 count.
screens.navigationContract: Library tab; switch to Grammar; select vocabulary to detail.

screens.name: Grammar Library
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: olen/olet, -ko/-kö, en+verb, -ssa/-ssä, Minulla on, genitive -n.
screens.implementationRequirements: Practical titles first, pattern examples second, technical terms optional; later concepts clearly labelled rather than falsely familiar.
screens.navigationContract: Library tab; switch to Vocabulary; open current concept detail.

screens.name: Grammar Detail
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Inessive -ssa/-ssä, talo → talossa, kauppa → kaupassa, Helsinki → Helsingissä.
screens.implementationRequirements: Reference lesson supports short/full grammar explanations and examples; avoid implying automatic formation of every noun.
screens.navigationContract: Back to Grammar; optional practice from concept exercises, only after engine supports it.

screens.name: Vocabulary Detail
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: haluan = I want, canonical haluta, spoken recognition haluun, Haluan kahvia.
screens.implementationRequirements: Canonical lemma retains identity; learner-facing conjugated form is a teaching form; spoken notes are recognition-first and toggleable.
screens.navigationContract: Back to Vocabulary; practice item only when a reviewable exercise exists.

screens.name: Progress
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: A1 Foundations Unit 4; abilities: introduce yourself, ask simple questions, locations.
screens.implementationRequirements: Derive capabilities from explicit evidence/lesson completion, not percentages; never equate lesson completion to familiarity.
screens.navigationContract: Secondary route via Home capability preview; Back to previous screen.

screens.name: Onboarding / Welcome
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: “Finnish, at your own pace.” minä / sinä / suomi.
screens.implementationRequirements: No account, placement, quotas or subscriptions; strong editorial start; persist completion only when onboarding done.
screens.navigationContract: Get started → How Learning Works.

screens.name: Onboarding / How Learning Works
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Understand → Practise → Remember; minä olen, En tiedä.
screens.implementationRequirements: Three coherent principles rather than generic features; no streak or microphone messaging.
screens.navigationContract: Continue → Ready; support back as appropriate.

screens.name: Onboarding / Ready
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: A1 Foundations, Unit 1 Hello, hei/moi/kiitos; saved locally.
screens.implementationRequirements: Promise device-local save only; first run advances into actual Unit 1/first lesson or Home routing to it.
screens.navigationContract: Start learning → initial lesson or Home resume route.

screens.name: Settings
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Two toggles, device-local saved progress, Reset learning progress, About Version 0.1.
screens.implementationRequirements: Preferences persisted separately; reset preserves preferences; avoid an inert reminder toggle—implement notification permission/scheduling if enabled or clearly disable.
screens.navigationContract: Secondary route via Settings icon; Reset entry opens confirmation overlay.

screens.name: Exercise / Almost
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Selected “to Helsinki”; brief -ssä meaning “in” correction.
screens.implementationRequirements: Same answer geometry as Default/Correct, warm constructive colour, explicit wrong-but-useful explanation; records almost, not correct.
screens.navigationContract: Continue lesson step; no fake perfect result.

screens.name: Lesson Complete
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Unit 4.2 Saying “in”, talo → talossa; pattern returns in Review.
screens.implementationRequirements: Completed required lesson steps, not mastery; acknowledge practice and schedule exposed items; remain resumable.
screens.navigationContract: Continue next lesson if available or return Course; sample 4/5 exercise does not directly imply completion.

screens.name: Unit Complete
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Unit 4 complete; Next Unit 5 Food & quantities.
screens.implementationRequirements: Only after every required lesson/checkpoint; summary and still-reviewing explanation; next-unit dynamic.
screens.navigationContract: Continue to actual next unit, not fixed Course screenshot; Back to Course secondary.

screens.name: Review / Session Complete
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Ten items revisited; En tiedä., missä?, -ssa/-ssä.
screens.implementationRequirements: Quiet recap with reviewed items, no percentage or perfect-score banners; enqueue weak items by schedule.
screens.navigationContract: Back to Review or continue learning.

screens.name: Review / Nothing Ready
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: No due reviews now; “Olen täällä.” thematic motif.
screens.implementationRequirements: Do not invent next-due timestamps or falsely imply mastery; source due status from review engine.
screens.navigationContract: Continue learning/Home or Course.

screens.name: Library / No Search Results
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: No matches for raitiovaunu in currently encountered collection.
screens.implementationRequirements: Search does not imply word absent from Finnish; clear query without losing tab/filter context.
screens.navigationContract: Clear search → Vocabulary Library.

screens.name: Loading
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Content-shaped muted placeholders and “Getting your lesson ready…”
screens.implementationRequirements: Only show when local hydration/content loading actually requires it; avoid endless shimmer.
screens.navigationContract: Return to requested content or recover gracefully.

screens.name: Offline
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Local data survives offline; available content can continue.
screens.implementationRequirements: Local-first: do not block bundled lessons unnecessarily; content availability must be verified in implementation.
screens.navigationContract: Continue available learning; Retry only for actual unavailable resource.

screens.name: Error
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: “Something didn’t load.” Try again / Back to Home.
screens.implementationRequirements: Error copy must not guarantee data preserved if storage is corrupted; keep actionable retry and safe back.
screens.navigationContract: Try again → Loading (prototype only); Back to Home.

screens.name: Reset Confirmation
screens.visualSourceStatus: approved Nordic Editorial Figma mockup (content is illustrative where Unit 4 appears)
screens.sampleContent: Clear learning history and review progress on this device; preferences remain unchanged.
screens.implementationRequirements: Cancel primary/safe; confirm explicitly clears learner state and preserves preferences; sheet focus/labels and dismissals need native validation.
screens.navigationContract: Settings → open; Cancel → Settings; Confirm → reset and route to first-run state.

routeConventions.transient: answer/feedback/loading/offline/error/no-search/nothing-ready are not separate navigable Figma pages
routeConventions.languageScoping: Selected learning language resolves the course/data registry; routes may remain language-agnostic if language is held in persisted app context; all domain progress keyed by target language.

implementationStages.1: Expo foundation and shared design system
implementationStages.2: Structured Unit 1 content + functional lesson vertical slice
implementationStages.5: Completion, system states, accessibility and device QA

brand.wordmarkStatus: legacy Figma visual reference only; replace before publishing

learningLanguages.languageSelectionUi: Do not expose Swedish until reviewed Swedish curriculum is available
